nodes.name: ds-core.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec introducing the DataSource abstraction layer (DataSource interface, LocalServeSource, DataSourceContext + useDataSource hook) for the React web frontend; pure addition, no component changes.

nodes.name: ds-wire.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec wiring App and container components to useDataSource() and gating write controls on capabilities.canWrite; closes P1 by replacing direct api.ts imports with the new abstraction.

nodes.name: fe-apihygiene.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec consolidating web/src/lib/api.ts mutations through the shared writeJSON helper so error extraction is consistent across all POST/PUT/DELETE calls.

nodes.name: fe-codesplit.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec splitting the production bundle via vite manualChunks (react, xyflow canvas, crypto-relay) to address Vercel 500kB chunk warnings while preserving all functionality.

nodes.name: fe-drilldown.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec adding a TaskDetail panel that decrypts and displays event history for the selected task card in hosted (RelaySource) mode, with graceful local-mode fallback.

nodes.name: fe-lazycanvas.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec converting the Canvas view to React.lazy + Suspense so the xyflow chunk loads on demand rather than in the initial bundle.

nodes.name: fe-lazyrelay.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec making RelaySource and RelayClient dynamic imports in source.ts so the crypto-relay chunk is only fetched when a hosted user connects; local mode bundle excludes it entirely.

nodes.name: fe-machines.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec adding a hosted-only Machines view that lists machines in the user's account (host, online state, agent kinds) via RelaySource.getMachines; read-only, local-mode degrades gracefully.

nodes.name: fe-remote-orchestrate.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec for the M4 hosted UI entry point to select a target machine and fire orchestrate.run / orchestrate.resume RPCs through RelaySource.

nodes.name: finishstep-core.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec adding the finish delivery step: a Finisher type with injected Runner that pushes the merged branch and optionally opens a PR via gh, plus the pactify finish cobra command.

nodes.name: integration-docs.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec for M3.4 relay integration tests (fsnotify -> drainNew -> relay envelope, plus failure isolation) and corresponding architecture/operations documentation.

nodes.name: liveview-step1.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec making the orchestrate loop emit a machine-readable Status snapshot to .pact/orchestrate/status.json at every action and terminal state; status.go + atomic writer + loop instrumentation.

nodes.name: liveview-step2.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec exposing GET /api/projects/{id}/orchestrate/status that reads the step1 status.json file and returns an OrchestrateStatusDTO (present+raw status bytes) for the live panel to poll.

nodes.name: liveview-step3.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec adding a React LiveOrchestrate panel wired to the step2 status endpoint, polling on refreshTick, with branches for absent / escalated / done / running states and a new 'live' view in TopBar.

nodes.name: obs-runduration.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec fixing RUN/task duration math so the changes_requested (rework) window is counted as active work instead of being frozen, keeping in_progress/awaiting_review/accepted semantics unchanged.

nodes.name: p3-relay-client.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec extracting the framework-agnostic relay read client into the cloud workspace package @pactify-apps/relay-client (login, listProjects, getProjectEvents, subscribe, decrypt) shared by Svelte and React fronts.

nodes.name: p3-relay-source.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec implementing web/'s RelaySource (implements DataSource) over @pactify-apps/relay-client: decrypt events, project to State via @pactify-apps/pact-project, capabilities.canWrite=false (read-only).

nodes.name: pact-project.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec adding the cloud workspace package @pactify-apps/pact-project with the pure function project(events) => State, parity-tested byte-for-byte against the Go projection via golden fixtures.

nodes.name: planner-apply.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec for internal/planner.Apply that validates a plan (Validate + spec files exist) and emits pact Assign events for each task; full validate-before-emit, partial-count on mid-stream failure.

nodes.name: planner-cmd.md
nodes.summary: Pact task spec for pactify plan / pactify plan apply cobra subcommands: collect RepoTree+roster, run planner agent via cmd.Runner, optionally chain into apply and orchestrate.
